She is known both for her mellifluous presentation of ragas and her chaste diction. Her rendition of devotional music in South Indian languages as well as in Hindi has won her a whole class of music-lovers. She has also acted in a few films

Subbulakshmi has, through the years, won world-wide recognition and acclaim. Born in 1916, M.S.-which is how she is endearingly referred to by her legion of admirers, received her training in Karnatak music from her mother, Shamu- gavadivu.
For her eminence in the field of Music and her con- tribution to its enrichment Smt. Subbulakshmi has been elected Fellow of the Sangeet Natak Akademi.
